scope: Read-only proposal and point-in-time recheck; isolated synthetic development candidates
limitations: Recheck compares decrypted customer/operation content at one point in time; it is not an atomic write guard.
Proposal choices and unsaved drafts remain volatile and are hidden/cleared by existing lock behavior; no durable proposal storage was added.
No deployed integration or physical Safari acceptance is claimed.
